question: Which of the following dance forms originated in Kuchelapuri or Kuchelapuram, in the 3rd century BC in South India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **dance form that originated in Kuchelapuram, also known as Kuchipudi**, is one of the eight major classical dances of India
 
• **Kuchipudi originates from the village of Kuchelapuram in the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It is a** classical Indian art form that combines dance, drama, and music.**
 
• **Kuchipudi has its roots in the ancient Hindu Sanskrit text of *****Natya** Shastra*.
 
• Traditional instruments used in Kuchipudi performances include the mridangam, cymbals, veena, flute, and tambura.
 
• This dance-drama style beautifully blends *Nritta* (pure dance), *Nritya* (expressional dance), and *Natya* (drama) to narrate stories, often of mythological significance.
